findings.description: JSM :asset L2 resolver (jsm_create.rs::resolve_asset_field_l2) dropped the platform sibling's (field_resolve.rs::compose_asset_hint) 4-check value-shape validation -- a malformed :asset value (missing ':', empty workspace segment, empty/non-numeric object-id segment) was not rejected before the workspace-discovery GET, diverging from DEC-188's pre-flight-guard convention
:asset cold-cache 4-row failure taxonomy (VP-578-022) lacked negative-path tests for the four malformed value shapes

EC-3.8.008-1 (:option cascading opacity on JSM) and EC-3.8.008-3 (L2-validation ordering) wording in BC-3.8.008 conflicted with the shipped code's actual behavior -- BC drafted-by-analogy against an OBJECT-wrap wire shape that contradicted AC-002's bare-parity STRING-wrap and the shipped code

passes.notes: Pass 1 BLOCKING: 1 HIGH + 2 MEDIUM. Fixes applied: ported field_resolve.rs::compose_asset_hint's 4-check value-shape validation into jsm_create.rs::resolve_asset_field_l2 verbatim (same checks, same precedence, same message strings -- tracked as duplicated debt, S-578-3-SHARED-ASSET-VALIDATOR); added 4 negative-path tests (missing ':', empty workspace, empty/non-numeric object-id) each asserting exit 64 + exact message + .expect(0) on both the workspace GET and POST mock; corrected BC-3.8.008 EC-3.8.008-1/EC-3.8.008-3 wording to STRING_WRAP per PO adjudication (see cycles/cycle-002/lessons.md content lesson on the wire-shape spec conflict).
Pass 2 NITPICK_ONLY -- convergence window starts (1/3). No source-level BLOCKING/MEDIUM/HIGH findings; residual observations only (test-naming, doc-phrasing).
Pass 3 NITPICK_ONLY -- window at 2/3. Residual observations only, no source-level fixes required.
Pass 4 CLEAN -- window COMPLETE (3/3). No findings of any severity, including nitpick. CONVERGED.
